claims.claim_text: Random file splitting creates substantial known same-family train/test overlap in LMD.
claims.forbidden_wording: All LMD leakage is known or measured.
claims.permitted_wording: Random file splitting creates substantial known same-family overlap in LMD.

claims.claim_text: Controlled family leakage inflates Transformer evaluation on treated families.
claims.forbidden_wording: Leakage always improves every model or dataset.
claims.permitted_wording: Controlled designated-donor exposure reduced treated-family NLL relative to controls.

claims.claim_text: The Transformer effect persists for structurally non-exact variants.
claims.forbidden_wording: All non-exact works are distinct compositions.
claims.permitted_wording: The frozen structurally-nonexact LMD stratum showed a same-direction effect.

claims.claim_text: Leakage susceptibility varies with architecture and Transformer capacity.
claims.forbidden_wording: Universal scaling law; replicated across architectures.
claims.permitted_wording: Results support capacity-and-architecture dependence in the evaluated configurations.

claims.claim_text: A reduced PDMX external cohort supports a same-direction family-specific effect.
claims.permitted_wording: A 67-family eligible reduced PDMX cohort supports a same-direction effect.

claims.claim_text: Exact deduplication alone does not remove known arrangement-family leakage.
claims.forbidden_wording: Exact deduplication is ineffective for every corpus.
claims.permitted_wording: Exact deduplication left 161 known cross-split families in the frozen 4,300-file pool.

claims.claim_text: Family-aware component splitting removes known family overlap without deleting data.
claims.forbidden_wording: Guaranteed zero latent leakage without complete family labels.
claims.permitted_wording: Family-aware assignment achieved zero known family overlap with 100% retention in the frozen pool.
